_comment: CLEARLY FAKE passwords for the fake demo personas only. Each subject pairs an OSINT-LINKED weak password (reachable by the targeted-guess simulator) with a STRUCTURAL TWIN that is NOT in the subject's OSINT material (same shape, so zxcvbn rates it identically, but it survives the targeted attack), plus a strong random control. The twins force the learned model to use exposure/trivia features rather than raw password structure, and demonstrate the thesis: context-free meters cannot tell rex2014 from fox2014. Real consented passwords must live in a gitignored file, never here.
